│ ↓/j         down                       q quit                                │
│ pgup/ctrl+u page up                                                          │
│ pgdn/ctrl+d page down                                                        │
│ home/g      first row                                                        │
│ end/G       last row                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ The wheel scrolls a list as ↑ and ↓ do. ? or esc closes this page.           │
